about: Hook types every Otto concept draws from. A concept = one angle for one persona; ship it with at least 3 hooks of DIFFERENT types. Placeholders in {braces} come from strategy.json. Meta limits: primary text first 125 chars carry the hook; headline <= 40 chars.

types.name: Call-out
types.example: Night-shift nurses: sleep through the day without melatonin fog
types.compliance: Never call out a health condition or personal attribute in restricted categories (Meta personal-attributes policy). Call out a situation or role instead.

types.name: Contrarian
types.example: More THC means stronger CBD? Not quite.
types.compliance: The correction must be provable from the proof bank.

types.name: Mistake
types.example: The 3 mistakes people make when choosing a CBD oil
types.compliance: Mistakes must be general, not about the reader's body or finances.

types.name: Number / specific
types.example: 40 seconds that settle the full vs broad question
types.compliance: Numbers only from the proof bank or the content itself (e.g. video length).

types.name: POV / scenario
types.example: POV: you're in the shop and every label says 'spectrum'
types.compliance: No before/after bodies, no suffering imagery.

types.name: Myth vs fact
types.example: Myth: CBD gets you high. Fact: CBD is non-intoxicating.
types.compliance: Fact must be sourced; no medical efficacy claims.

types.name: Review quote
types.example: "The quality feels clean and trustworthy" — Melanie S.
types.compliance: Verbatim only, with consent; no health outcomes in restricted categories.

types.name: Comparison
types.template: {option_a} vs {option_b}: which one is for you?
types.example: Full vs broad vs isolate: which one is for you?
types.compliance: Compare your own products or categories, never a named competitor's claims.

types.name: Price maths
types.template: {price} a month is {per_day} a day. Here is what that buys.
types.example: €45 is €1.50 a day. Here is what that buys.
types.compliance: Real prices from the site; show the full price, no hidden conditions.

types.name: Checklist before you buy
types.template: {n} things to check before you buy any {category}
types.example: 3 things to check before you buy any CBD
types.compliance: Each check must be something the brand actually passes (lab report, origin…).

types.name: Founder / origin
types.example: Why we publish every lab report: we were tired of guessing too.
types.compliance: True story only; ask the owner (onboarding question) before using.

types.name: Objection first
types.compliance: Answer with facts from the proof bank; no guarantees.

types.name: Offer with a real deadline
types.example: Starter bundle -20% until Sunday. We're clearing the autumn batch.
types.compliance: Deadline must be real (Omnibus 30-day prior-price rule in the EU).

rules: At least 3 hooks per concept, from at least 2 different types.
The first 3 seconds of a reel = the hook, on screen and spoken, frame 0 already designed.
Write in the customer's words from strategy.json pains/objections; ban 'unlock', 'elevate', 'seamless', 'game-changer', 'revolutionary'.
Every hook passes brands/<slug>/compliance.json before it reaches the owner.
